message.content: ThaneChambers expresses enthusiasm for the inclusion of stealth mechanics in the game, believing they offer a wide array of possibilities and unique gameplay experiences. He believes that stealth can significantly enhance the depth and variety of the game, providing opportunities for creative strategies and adding an element of surprise and excitement. Specifically, ThaneChambers highlights the potential for epic moments and shared experiences among players when successfully executing stealth maneuvers together. This sentiment suggests that he sees stealth boosts as a valuable addition that could transform gameplay dynamics within a cooperative context.
